blockers.message: Ethics approval status 'pending' is not acceptable for review.
Consent coverage is missing for: icu-patients.
Consent terms do not explicitly allow prize challenge analysis and review.
Raw ICU encounter extract lacks a frozen checksum.
Raw ICU encounter extract still contains direct identifiers.
Raw ICU encounter extract must be aggregate, deidentified, synthetic, or controlled.
Raw ICU encounter extract has high re-identification risk.
HIPAA-scoped submission lacks minimum-necessary review evidence.
GDPR-scoped submission lacks a lawful basis for challenge processing.
Cross-border processing is enabled without a transfer mechanism.
Human-subject data processing requires a data-use agreement or equivalent control.
Clinical reviewer lacks current human-subjects training.
Clinical reviewer has not signed a conflict declaration.
Clinical reviewer has raw-data access outside a private challenge.
IP release is configured before human-subject compliance approval.
Payout is configured before human-subject compliance approval.

warnings.message: Ethics evidence is present but does not include a protocol identifier.
Participant withdrawal window is still open during challenge evaluation.
No privacy escalation contact is recorded for regulated data.
Clinical reviewer access expires before the evaluation window ends.
Sponsor has not acknowledged that compliance blockers can hold review, payout, or IP transfer.

readySignals: 1 human-subject artifact(s) were inspected for identifiers, privacy level, and checksum state.
1 reviewer access record(s) were checked for training, conflicts, and least privilege.
remediationActions: Resolve pending or rejected ethics approval before exposing the submission.
Record a protocol ID so the arbitration packet can be independently checked.
Map consent or waiver evidence to every declared participant group.
Confirm challenge participation is within consented research use.
Delay final award review until the withdrawal window closes or freeze affected rows.
Freeze Raw ICU encounter extract with a checksum before reviewer access.
Remove direct identifiers from Raw ICU encounter extract or keep it outside the challenge workspace.
Classify privacy level for Raw ICU encounter extract and restrict access accordingly.
Reduce quasi-identifier detail or move Raw ICU encounter extract into controlled access.
Attach minimum-necessary review before sponsor or reviewer access.
Record lawful basis and data subject rights route before evaluation.
Add SCC, adequacy, or other transfer mechanism evidence.
Attach DUA or equivalent controlled-access agreement.
Update human-subjects training for Clinical reviewer.
Collect conflict declaration from Clinical reviewer.
Limit raw-data access to private challenge reviewers only.
Gate IP transfer until compliance hold is cleared and payout is approved.
Hold payout until compliance approval is recorded.
